svg.metadata:
flowchart TD say(["What you tell it, or ask it"]) --> llm["Your LLM chooses tools and fills them in"]
subgraph logged ["What it logs"] direction LR event["Workouts, illness, sex, stress"] subst["Medicines, caffeine, alcohol"] sleep["Sleep and activity"] food["Food and drink"] you["Your body and cycle"] end
llm --> event llm --> subst llm --> sleep llm --> food llm --> you usda[(USDA food table)] -.-> food
event --> day["Your day"] subst --> day sleep --> day food --> day you --> day
subgraph model ["Physiology model: every minute of the day"] direction LR signals["Stress, immunity, alertness, mood"] circ["Heart, lungs, fluids, temperature"] muscles["Muscles and recovery"] sugar["Sugar, insulin, blood fat"] gut["Digestion and absorption"] hormones["Hormones and cycle"] end
day --> model model --> out(["The body, its readings, the day chart and walkthroughs"])
